bug_semantics: GET /a/share/link/{Uuid} (SharesHandler.GetShareLink in idm/share/rest/handler.go) returns the full ShareLink object for a workspace UUID with no READ authorization. The handler reads the path UUID, calls LinkById, and writes the result. LinkById reaches GetLinkWorkspace, which calls GetOrCreateWorkspace with a nil owner and SearchWorkspace carrying only a WorkspaceSingleQuery and no ResourcePolicyQuery; PrepareResourcePolicyQuery returns that query unmodified when ResourcePolicyQuery is nil, so the workspace service applies no policy filter. Sibling GET /a/share/cell/{Uuid} (GetCell) loads the workspace then requires MatchPolicies(..., ResourcePolicyAction_READ) and returns CellNotFound so existence is not disclosed. The UUID is not secret: the unauthenticated /public/{hash} minisite embeds it as START_REPOSITORY. Any standard-role account can therefore recover LinkHash and LinkUrl, the owner's user identifier, the hidden share-user login, permissions, download limit and count, target users, expiry, and PasswordRequired, while a direct read of the shared node by the same account is refused (CWE-862).
flaw_origin: The missing-authorization GetShareLink handler was first written in the 2018-04-21 public import c5cb0b5a19bd84e5ad8f41260fadbc27a8979a22 (author/committer cdujeu <charles@ajaxplorer.info>, subject 'Pydio Cells'). That commit added idm/share/rest/rest.go GetShareLink, which loaded a LINK workspace by UUID via GetOrCreateWorkspace (SearchWorkspace with no policy query) and wrote WorkspaceToShareLinkObject with neither MatchPolicies nor IsContextEditable, while PutShareLink/DeleteShareLink in the same file already used IsContextEditable. potential_fix.approach: In GetShareLink, after loading the workspace (LinkById/GetLinkWorkspace), enforce the same MatchPolicies(ctx, id, workspace.Policies, ResourcePolicyAction_READ) gate already used by GetCell and return a not-found error on failure; alternatively set ResourcePolicyQuery on the SearchWorkspace request inside GetLinkWorkspace/GetOrCreateWorkspace so lookup is policy-filtered.
potential_fix.rationale: A handler-level READ check (or a policy-filtered workspace search) closes the authorization hole that currently lets any authenticated standard user read owner-only share-link metadata by UUID, matching the sibling GetCell behavior and the reporter's suggested fix on issue 981.
